package tag

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteTag removes tag by id.
type DeleteTag struct {
	Tags repository.TagRepository
}

// Handle deletes tag.
func (uc DeleteTag) Handle(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	return uc.Tags.Delete(ctx, id)
}
